contract.interface:
The target is an infinite translation-invariant one-dimensional spin chain H=-t/2 sum(XX+YY)+Hdiag, with bounded finite-range real density interactions of arbitrary strength, t!=0 and Lindbladian L O=i[H,O]+gamma sum_i(Z_i O Z_i-O), d=4gamma>0. The reference is tracial infinite-temperature half-density, susceptibility chi=1/4. Number is conserved, energy is not. Dephasing is part of the physical target, not a free regularizer. Supplied local coefficients or active constant-patch preparation/switching replace N742's passive Gibbs-copy interface. A scalar transport decision is not a universal rare-information escape.

The source claims existence of the ordinary long-time density-response second-moment coefficient D=lim_{T->infinity} sum_x x^2 <e^{TL}(n_x-1/2),n_0-1/2>/(2T chi), with 2t^2 d/(d^2+Xi)<=D<=2t^2/d. Xi is the uniform conditional mean square local hopping detuning, conditioned on unequal neighboring occupations. This is not a Gaussian hydrodynamic limit, positivity of every density-response entry, a convergence rate, finite-temperature theorem or zero-dephasing result. No global spectral gap, mixing or strong-dephasing promise is assumed.

For finite periodic response kappa_n=n^-1<J,(S+A)^-1 J> on the fixed-point complement, S is the positive dissipative part, A the skew Hamiltonian part and P the population kernel of S. Odd f must satisfy exact PAf=0. Lower L(f)=2<J,f>-<f,Sf>-<Af,S^+Af> and upper U(g)=<J-Ag,Sodd^-1(J-Ag)>+<g,Sg> sandwich n kappa_n. Their gap is the sum of S^+-squared residuals Sf-(J-Ag), Sg+Af. Dropping the undamped-population constraint is invalid. From even off-diagonal g0, solve M phi=-b with M=-PA Sodd^-1 A P and b=PA Sodd^-1(J-Ag0); g=g0+phi and f=Sodd^-1(J-Ag) then satisfy balance. On populations M phi(eta)=2/d sum_e t_e^2[phi(eta)-phi(eta^swap)], an exact static exclusion constraint, not a replacement of full quantum dynamics by classical dynamics.

At supplied Walsh degree<=p the population space has sum_{k<=p}binom(n,k) terms and rational gauge-fixed pressure solving is polynomial for fixed p. The missing G1 theorem must bound total off-diagonal witness representation, pressure degree, arithmetic, memory and verification polynomially in n, coefficient bits and epsilon^-1 at bounded nonperturbative parameters. Fixed-degree experiments do not prove this closure. The infinite-chain argument instead uses fixed-time locality, regularized Schur monotonicity, a positive even current spectral measure and a tail-controlled Tauberian passage to the ordinary Cesaro second moment D=4kappa_0. It does not interchange unregularized finite-size/time limits or supply a usable thermodynamic error rate. Gaussian profiles remain separate G2.

For nearest/next-nearest density interactions U,V, Xi=[(U-V)^2+V^2]/2. At t=1,U=4,V=1, d=2 yields D>=4/9; the same H at d=16 has D<=1/8, a conditional mathematical ratio>=32/9. The local Ramsey assay assumes calibrated t,d, detuning bound Lambda, incident-hop freezing preserving diagonal energies, reproducible local neighbor occupations, pair superposition and logical-X readout. Its mean is exp(-d tau) E cos(Delta tau). With Lambda=4,tau=1/4,N=100000, Hoeffding radius1/90 and observed mean>=.51, the displayed conditional 99% bounds give Xi<=15458/2475, D>=4950/12679 and ratio>3.12. N tau=25000 native time units excludes preparation/switch/readout/calibration. The threshold is demonstrated on synthetic outcomes only; failing it is inconclusive and one patch cannot verify the global model.

Exact finite Pauli/pressure checks and floating ring certificates support debugging. No high-precision closure, specialized-solver advantage, physical implementation, independent correctness or historical novelty is established. N742 remains intact; N744 microscopic control and Laughlin gap hypotheses were explicitly not imported. The next gate is a fully charged balanced-certificate construction and physical interface acquisition, not a declaration of transformative predictive power.
